describes: Signed identity bindings (#188, docs/identity-binding.md). Each case is a binding as received, the keys and identities the verifier holds independently, the clock, and the outcome every platform must reach. `signingBytesHex` is the exact canonical bytes both signatures cover. The keys are test-only.

cases.name: valid-master-key
cases.describes: both signatures check; the Matrix half by the master key fetched from the homeserver

cases.name: valid-master-key-user-verified
cases.describes: the same binding when Chat has user-verified the master key: still binding-valid here; `verified` is Chat's to say

cases.name: valid-device-key
cases.describes: a binding signed by a device key is valid at lower trust

cases.name: valid-p256-card-key
cases.describes: a card key on the ECDSA P-256 fallback signs a valid binding

cases.name: expired
cases.describes: past expiresAt: earns nothing, and is not re-signed by anybody but the owner

cases.name: not-yet-valid
cases.describes: issued more than the skew allowance in the verifier's future

cases.name: wrong-domain
cases.describes: valid signatures over another domain are not a binding

cases.name: unknown-version
cases.describes: a v2 binding is kept for a newer build, not judged

cases.name: tampered-mesh-id
cases.describes: the statement was changed after signing

cases.name: matrix-signature-by-another-key
cases.describes: the card half is genuine, the Matrix half was made by a key that is not the named one

cases.name: signed-by-another-card-key
cases.describes: a binding signed by somebody else's card key, presented on this card

cases.name: names-another-card-key
cases.describes: signed by this card key but naming another: the statement is not about this card

cases.name: someone-elses-mesh-id
cases.describes: a genuine binding for another mesh identity, replayed on a card claiming this one

cases.name: someone-elses-mxid
cases.describes: the sharpest attack: a card naming @alice with a binding that never mentions her

cases.name: revoked
cases.describes: the signer withdrew this id; replaying it after revocation earns `revoked`

cases.name: no-matrix-key-held
cases.describes: offline, with no cached key: the card half checks, the binding stays unverifiable

cases.name: held-key-is-not-the-signing-key
cases.describes: the verifier holds a different key id for the account: unverifiable, not invalid

cases.name: malformed-no-expiry
cases.describes: v1 requires an expiry

cases.name: malformed-validity-too-long
cases.describes: more than 180 days of validity is refused as malformed

cases.name: malformed-unknown-field
cases.describes: a field v1 does not define is refused: a signature covers nothing a reader ignores

cases.name: malformed-mesh-as-matrix-id
cases.describes: binding a mesh identity to itself says nothing

cases.name: not-an-object
cases.describes: a string where a binding should be
